dz: 安华太子起事起事后,朱子范杀死了所有被邀入宴会的官吏,并宣布他打算在正德皇帝统治期间罢免有势力的明朝太监刘仁.
de: The Prince of Anhua rebellion begins when Zhu Zhifan kills all the officials invited to a banquet and declares his intent on ousting the powerful Ming dynasty eunuch Liu Jin during the reign of the Zhengde Emperor.

de: During the reign of the Zhengde Emperor, Ming dynasty rebel leader Zhu Zhifan is defeated by commander Qiu Yue, ending the Prince of Anhua rebellion.

dz: 葡萄牙征服果阿:由阿丰索·德·阿尔布开克指挥的葡萄牙海军和为私家提莫吉工作的当地雇佣兵从比贾普尔苏丹国手中夺取了果阿,导致葡萄牙长达451年的殖民统治.
de: Portuguese conquest of Goa: Portuguese naval forces under the command of Afonso de Albuquerque, and local mercenaries working for privateer Timoji, seize Goa from the Bijapur Sultanate, resulting in 451 years of Portuguese colonial rule.
